svg.aria-label: General guidance for any formula and trace. Work down five questions. Does the formula document read back as the requirement; is every proposition bound to the intended signal; does the rewritten formula give the original verdict; do tl-mltl and tl-oracle return the same verdict; does the monitor verdict match tl-mltl. The first answer of no points at the stage to inspect: text or parse, binding, rewrite, evaluator, or monitor mapping. If every answer is yes, the verdict stands for this input and the requirement or the recorded trace is what to re-read.
